source_url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.03884 (Associated publication: FLNet: Flood-Induced Agriculture Damage Assessment using Super Resolution of Satellite Images)
license: Research Use Only / Contact Authors (Direct public open repository download is currently not indexed)
download_date: 2026-10-01 (Documentation & Adapter specification date; local data directory data/raw/bfcd22/ ready for user archive placement)
temporal_coverage: October 2022 Bihar flood event (pre-flood and post-flood pair)
geographic_coverage: Muzaffarpur district, Bihar, India (specific riverine cropland AOI; does NOT cover all 38 Bihar districts)

label_definition.1: Partial damage (submerged foliage, lodging, silt deposition, reduced NDVI)
label_definition.2: Full damage (complete crop washout, permanent water stagnation, severe vegetation mortality)

known_limitations: Geographically localized to Muzaffarpur study zone; cannot be generalized across all Bihar agro-climatic zones without domain verification.
Direct public download link is not freely hosted online without institutional author request; user must place raw files into data/raw/bfcd22/.
Optical Sentinel-2 imagery is cloud-dependent during monsoonal cloud cover.
